name: OpenBookQA
intro: OpenBookQA是一个模拟开卷考试的问答数据集，旨在评估对一个学科的理解能力。该数据集提供一本包含1326个基础科学事实的“开卷”，并提出约6000个问题，这些问题需要结合开卷中的事实和广泛的常识来回答。
intro_en: OpenBookQA is an open-book exam-style QA dataset designed to assess understanding of a subject. It provides an "open book" containing 1,326 basic science facts and poses about 6,000 questions that require combining these facts with broad commonsense knowledge to answer.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1809.02789. The authors filter 2,287 WorldTree facts marked central to 1,326 general elementary-science facts. A qualified crowd worker receives a core fact f, supplies a second common fact k, derives an assertion, converts it into a question-answer pair, and adds three incorrect choices. Automatic checks require exactly four choices, no listed negation words, and uniform answer length. IR and word-association solvers must fail and their top three retrieved sentences must be insufficient; easy items are edited and retried. Five new workers answer each question and at least four must be correct. Choices are shuffled, Dev/Test receive in-house expert review, and 5,957 questions are split 4,957/500/500. Evaluation awards one point for a correct choice or 1/k for a correct answer inside a k-way tie.
